t: The LAP square 595mm x 595mm LED panel light is a high-performance lighting solution for various commercial and trade applications. This 36W cool white LED panel delivers 3600 lumens, providing bright and efficient illumination. Its slim design, featuring an aluminium frame and plastic diffuser, makes it ideal for shallow ceiling voids in offices, workshops, and retail environments. Installation is straightforward with the included bracket and security cable, ensuring a quick and secure fit. Designed for indoor use, this non-dimmable panel offers a long operational life of up to 25,000 hours, reducing maintenance needs.
